name: Wipro

Project Engineer (Elite/NLTH).dsaDepth: Light - 2 easy–moderate coding problems inside a broader aptitude test; interview is fundamentals-heavy, not algorithm-heavy
rounds: Online test (about 128 min): aptitude (quant, logical reasoning, verbal), a written communication/essay section, and an online programming section (2 problems, C/C++/Java/Python, easy–moderate)
Technical interview (about 20–25 min): OOP pillars, access specifiers, polymorphism/encapsulation/abstraction, DBMS/SQL basics, project discussion, sometimes a small live-coding task
HR interview: background, motivation, relocation, backlog/gap questions
extraTopics: Composure and clarity, since panels are described as friendly but fundamentals-focused
